tree_state: README, inventory.py and decision 0019 are committed in the commit that follows this record; the recorded commit is its parent
summary: Reuse assessment of existing Exynos/DWC3 USB code and choice of the minimal text-and-exception log channel (EP0-only control-pull monitor); no phone used.

acceptance.1_inventory: README section 1 lists the pinned vendor kernel dwc3/Exynos glue/eUSB2/USBDP/repeater sources (all GPL-2.0, line counts regenerated by inventory.py), the upstream sweet DWC3 patches 0072-0077/0081 (reference only: Qualcomm SoC, XNU APIs, Apple-licensed patch files), the USB-001 profile, NAT-016 archive.py and NAT-013 patterns, and rejects S-Boot USB reuse; verdict per item.
acceptance.2_channel_comparison: README section 2 compares EP0 control-pull, bulk-IN push, CDC-ACM, ECM/UDP, S-Boot USB reuse, RAM retention, UFS tail write and UART; channels that need a return to S-Boot/Android are recorded as retention, not as the log channel.
acceptance.3_choice_and_children: README section 3 gives the chosen channel, the request set, record format, collector design reusing archive.py, and the verification criterion for the real run; section 4 maps each unknown to NAT-039/040/041/042/043, registered with dependencies.

established: The repository has no code that drives this controller on this SoC; the authoritative sources are the pinned GPL-2.0 vendor kernel files, listed with line counts and licence tags regenerated from git objects.
The vendor PHY driver initialises the USB2 (utmi/eUSB2, with repeater_enable) and USB3 (pipe3, USBDP combo) PHYs in separate functions.
not_established: That the S24 can be brought up as a USB device from the loader: HSI0 state after S-Boot, repeater selection, pipe-clock need, DMA coherency and every register value are unmeasured (NAT-039/040/043).
That a high-speed-only EP0 device can skip the USBDP combo PHY.
The wire format is a design; it is fixed and tested in NAT-041.
